blocks.text: Marvin Agustin is celebrating another milestone for his restaurant after it retained its Michelin Bib Gourmand distinction for the second consecutive year. The actor and entrepreneur announced the recognition in an Instagram post, expressing pride in his restaurant team for their efforts in maintaining the establishment’s standards. “For the second year in a row, COCHI By Marvin has been awarded the MICHELIN Bib Gourmand!” he wrote.
